instruction: A warehouse starts with 1921 boxes. Then the stock is split equally into 2 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). It receives 2 deliveries of 24 boxes each. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
